question: What temperature range should unopened solder paste be kept at?
answer: 2.1 Unopened solder paste jars are stored in the paste refrigerator at 2 to 10 degC. [SOP-PRN-001 section 2]

question: How long can paste stay on the stencil before it has to be thrown away?
answer: 2.2 Before opening, a jar must warm up at room temperature for at least 4 hours. Do not heat paste to speed up warm-up. [SOP-PRN-001 section 2]

question: How often is the underside of the stencil cleaned?
answer: 4.3 The stencil underside is cleaned automatically every 10 prints (wet-vacuum-dry cycle). [SOP-PRN-001 section 4]

question: What happens after three SPI failures in a row?
answer: 5.1 Three consecutive SPI failures stop the printer automatically. [SOP-PRN-001 section 5]

question: When does a pick-and-place operator have to call maintenance for a head calibration?
answer: 5.3 If the warning repeats twice within one shift, the operator must stop the machine and call maintenance for a head calibration (see SOP-MNT-008). [SOP-PNP-002 section 5]

question: What is the floor life of a level 3 moisture-sensitive part after its dry pack is opened?
answer: 6.1 Moisture-sensitive components of level 3 have a floor life of 168 hours after the dry pack is opened. [SOP-PNP-002 section 6]

question: Which board of a work order needs a first-article inspection on the placement machine?
answer: 4.1 The first board of each work order is placed and then inspected under the microscope against the assembly drawing before the rest of the lot is released. [SOP-PNP-002 section 4]

question: What is the allowed time above liquidus in the reflow profile?
answer: 2.2 Time above liquidus (217 degC): 45 to 75 seconds. [SOP-RFL-003 section 2]

question: How often is the reflow profile checked with the profiler board?
answer: 3.1 The profile is verified once per day, at the start of shift A, with the thermocouple profiler board. [SOP-RFL-003 section 3]

question: What oxygen level is allowed in the reflow tunnel in nitrogen mode?
answer: 4.1 The oxygen level in the reflow tunnel must stay below 1000 ppm when nitrogen mode is used. [SOP-RFL-003 section 4]

question: Within what time must an AOI FAIL call be reviewed?
answer: 4.1 Every unit called FAIL is reviewed by a trained inspector at the review station within 30 minutes. [SOP-AOI-004 section 4]

question: Can a line operator change an AOI FAIL result to PASS?
answer: 4.3 An operator may not override a FAIL call to PASS. Only an inspector with review authorisation may do this, and the reason must be recorded. [SOP-AOI-004 section 4]

question: How long are AOI inspection images kept?
answer: 6.1 Inspection images are kept for 90 days on the AOI server and then deleted automatically. [SOP-AOI-004 section 6]

question: How many times may a defective unit be repaired?
answer: 5.2 A defective unit may be repaired at most twice. After a second failed repair it is scrapped. [SOP-AOI-004 section 5]

question: At which point in the route may a lot be split?
answer: The SOP documents do not appear to cover this question.

question: What is the maximum number of units in a released lot?
answer: 2.1 Lots are released from a work order with at most 96 units per lot. [WI-MES-005 section 2]

question: What conditions must be met before two lots can be merged?
answer: 4.1 Lots may be merged only if they belong to the same work order and have completed the AOI step. [WI-MES-005 section 4]

question: When is a nonconformance report opened because of the defect rate?
answer: 2.2 If the confirmed-defect rate is more than twice the baseline for two consecutive hours, a nonconformance report (NCR) is opened. [SOP-QA-006 section 2]

question: How quickly must the quality engineer be told about a new NCR?
answer: 3.1 The shift leader must notify the quality engineer within 1 hour of an NCR being opened. [SOP-QA-006 section 3]

question: Can a factor that is only used at the same time as the real cause be accepted as the root cause?
answer: 4.2 A factor is only accepted as a root cause when its effect remains after accounting for the other suspected factors; a factor that is merely used at the same time as the real cause is not a root cause. [SOP-QA-006 section 4]

question: What voltage window must a cell be in before assembly?
answer: 2.1 Every cell's open-circuit voltage is measured before assembly. Cells must be between 3.55 and 3.65 V. [SOP-BAT-007 section 2]

question: What is the minimum insulation resistance at the end-of-line test?
answer: 5.2 A module that fails the insulation test may not be reworked on the line; it is sent to the failure-analysis lab. [SOP-BAT-007 section 5]

question: How many boards are run to requalify equipment after maintenance?
answer: 4.1 After a PM or a repair, the equipment is requalified by running 5 boards that must all pass inspection. [SOP-MNT-008 section 4]

question: When must the ESD wrist strap test be repeated?
answer: 2.1 Every person entering the ESD area tests their wrist strap and ESD footwear at the tester at the entrance. [SOP-ESD-009 section 2]

question: Which solder paste supplier is approved for this line?
answer: The SOP documents do not appear to cover this question.

question: What conveyor speed in cm per minute is set on the reflow oven?
answer: 4.2 An oxygen alarm stops the conveyor entry; boards already in the oven complete the cycle. [SOP-RFL-003 section 4]

question: How long is the cure time for the conformal coating?
answer: The SOP documents do not appear to cover this question.

question: What is the maximum charging current during module formation?
answer: The SOP documents do not appear to cover this question.

question: How many hours of training does an AOI inspector need before getting review authorisation?
answer: 4.3 An operator may not override a FAIL call to PASS. Only an inspector with review authorisation may do this, and the reason must be recorded. [SOP-AOI-004 section 4]

question: What is the X-ray voiding limit for BGA solder joints?
answer: The SOP documents do not appear to cover this question.

question: What is the shelf life of an unopened solder paste jar in the refrigerator?
answer: 2.1 Unopened solder paste jars are stored in the paste refrigerator at 2 to 10 degC. [SOP-PRN-001 section 2]

question: Which torque is used for the screws of the AOI camera mount?
answer: 4.1 Busbar screws are tightened to 4.0 N m with a tolerance of plus or minus 0.2 N m using the controlled torque driver. [SOP-BAT-007 section 4]
